data.name: DataLoader_KeyParameterMissing
data.value: A DataLoader must at least provides a key or keys parameter

data.name: DataLoader_InvalidAccessModifier
data.value: The DataLoader access modifier must be public or internal

data.name: DataLoader_KeyParameterInvalid
data.value: The first parameter of a [DataLoader<T>] method must be {0}

data.name: DataLoader_ParameterModifierInvalid
data.value: DataLoader method parameters must not be ref/in/out/ref readonly

data.name: InterceptsAttribute
DataLoader_KeyedServiceAttributeConflict
data.value: A DataLoader service parameter cannot use both [Service(key)] and [FromKeyedServices]. Use one keyed-service attribute.

data.name: DataLoader_KeyedServiceAttributeIgnored
data.value: This keyed-service attribute has no effect here. Remove it or apply it to a DataLoader service parameter.

data.name: DataLoader_KeyedServiceOnConstructorParameter
data.value: A keyed [Service] attribute on a hand-written DataLoader constructor parameter is resolved as an unkeyed service. Use [FromKeyedServices] instead.

data.name: DataLoader_KeyedServiceKeyNotDeterminable
data.value: The key of this derived [Service] attribute cannot be determined at compile time. Define the attribute in source or apply the key directly.

data.name: DataLoader_MultipleAttributes
data.value: A method can have only one [DataLoader] attribute

data.name: DataLoader_DuplicateType
data.value: The DataLoader type '{0}' is used by multiple [DataLoader<T>] methods in this assembly and cannot be injected by interface

data.name: DataLoader_MissingInterfaceImplementation
data.value: The DataLoader type '{0}' declares members that must be implemented by the partial '{1}' class

data.name: DataLoader_PublicInterfaceAccessModifier
data.value: DataLoaderAccessModifier.PublicInterface is treated as Public on [DataLoader<T>] methods

data.name: DataLoader_ReturnTypeInvalid
data.value: The return type of a [DataLoader<T>] method must be {0}

data.name: DataLoader_TypeInvalid
data.value: The type argument of [DataLoader<T>] must be an interface that derives from exactly one closed IBatchDataLoader<TKey, TValue> or ICacheDataLoader<TKey, TValue> contract
